sources.label: orion shutter
sources.text: Orion shutter opens only when the measured sky brightness is below 3 units. At 3 units or above it stays closed.

sources.label: lyra rehearsal
sources.text: Lyra rehearsal assigns a slow practice pass when a phrase has more than 2 missed beats. With 2 or fewer missed beats it assigns a normal-tempo pass.

sources.label: umber display
sources.text: Umber display lights an artifact only when its permission flag is approved. A pending or denied flag keeps the artifact unlit.

sources.label: sienna sample
sources.text: Sienna sample retains a soil tube only when its seal code matches the collection log. A mismatched seal code causes the tube to be set aside without analysis.
